doc: Server-side trader watchlist for the checklist row Who's buying. A wallet counts as bought only when it currently holds this mint: either it is in the Solana holder list with a balance above zero, or getTokenAccountsByOwner returns a balance above zero. Names are Pump.fun usernames from GET https://frontend-api-v3.pump.fun/users/{address}. They are not invented handles. The panel prints a name only when that wallet holds the coin being checked. Add a row to track another wallet. Rows without a name or address are ignored.
